entries.rule: Rule 7 (use what was known at the entry's date) limits rule 6: the 2021 press release does not show the contra result; the contra comparison was first public in the registry, 2024-03-04
entries.note: Press release (Healio 2021-04-22) reported only no grade>=2 CRS/NT at 1800 mg and ORR 83%; the all-grade CRS 67%/NE rates carrying contra first appeared in registry results 2024-03-04 (CT.gov API). Keep 2024, as adjudicated before. Note's 'primary endpoint' wrong: phase 1 primary was DLTs.
entries.adjudication_note: Rules 6+7: status contra agreed; date it 2024 (registry 2024-03-04). The 2021 press release showed only no grade>=2 CRS/NT at 1800 mg, not the all-grade CRS/NE rates carrying contra, so the comparison was first public in 2024.

entries.note: ASH 2021 abstract confirmed: severe CRS 2/31 (6%), same 31 pts, axi-cel 74%, cites Giavridis for CRS and ICANS. Year 2021, anakinra, other_disease right; same+partial stands. Note's 'primary endpoint' wording fits ICANS, not this CRS entry.

Breyanzi SBRA (fda.gov/media/146242) quote verbatim. The filed rodent models named no CRS, neurotoxicity or margin; xenogeneic GVHD has no autologous patient counterpart. Untested 2015 opener, model_filed and product_in_model true, consistent with confirmed dose 2.

missing: Syngeneic BALB/c A20 lymphoma with anti-mouse CD19 CD28-CD3zeta CARs (Cheadle 2014, J Immunol, https://doi.org/10.4049/jimmunol.1302148, epub 2014-03-12): T-cell-dose-dependent acute toxicity with raised serum Th1 cytokines in preconditioned mice, absent in C57BL/6 and C3H recipients. A 2014 immunocompetent-mouse cytokine-toxicity retrodiction that bears directly on the C3H model's silence; no track.

Second 2010 syngeneic system: BALB/c A20 lymphoma with the amCD19z CAR (Cheadle 2010, J Immunol, https://doi.org/10.4049/jimmunol.0901440, epub 2010-01-20): eradicated disseminated A20 after 6 Gy TBI, but CAR T cells failed to persist, B cells returned, no autotoxicity. A prospective persistence/B-cell-aplasia prediction that the 2011-2012 patients contradicted; not relied on by a member, but a compared model with no track (untested or contra).

Humanized NSG-SGM3 patient-derived ALL xenograft CRS/neuroinflammation model with GM-CSF neutralization (Sterner 2019, Blood, https://doi.org/10.1182/blood-2018-10-881722, epub 2018-11-21, PMC6376281): a retrodiction with a prospective test in ZUMA-19 (NCT04314843, lenzilumab + axi-cel in LBCL; results posted 2024-03-04; phase 2 primary = grade >=2 neurologic events within 28 days), imported from LBCL. No track.

The Giavridis track's own prospective test: 'IL-1 blockade abates CRS' was tested in Park 2023 (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41591-023-02404-6: all-grade CRS 74%, severe 6.4%, LBCL/MCL) and in https://doi.org/10.1182/bloodadvances.2024015161 (2025: once-daily anakinra insufficient to prevent grade >=2 CRS/NT with axi-cel). Belongs on scid-beige-raji-crs-mouse as a dated entry (same + partial, or contra), not only on the Norelli track.

The safety cell has no entry for the liso-cel track (raji-nsg-xenograft-fmc63-41bb-car). The Breyanzi SBRA (https://www.fda.gov/media/146242/download) states: 'Animal studies to assess the long-term safety of BREYANZI were limited because BREYANZI does not survive in immunocompetent rodents and induces graft-versus-host disease in immunocompromised mice.' An untested 2015 opener with that quote.

Not found (reported, not a miss): no press release, SEC filing or EMA document reporting a member failure in FL (ZUMA-5, TRANSCEND FL, RELIANCE all positive); no FL patient-derived organoid or ex-vivo system used to pick CAR-T patients surfaced in Europe PMC. I ran no dedicated WebSearch, so an FL-specific ex-vivo model could still exist.
could_not_verify: Full text of Kochenderfer 2010 (PMC2981541), Kochenderfer 2012 (PMC3327450) and the 2010 case report (PMC2993617): Europe PMC fullTextXML returned HTTP 500, PMC HTML returned a challenge page, NCBI efetch served front matter only then rate-limited (not retried), and the PubMed plugin returned empty full_text. The three draft quotes from those bodies (Introduction comparison sentence, hypogammaglobulinemia sentence, Discussion B-cell warning) and the Table 1 FL assignments are therefore abstract-level only.
Giavridis 2018 and Park 2023 full texts (same blocks); their quotes are verbatim in the abstracts.
rule_questions: Species-silence exemption: v3 safety says silence is a miss on 'a harm the species could have shown' and in the next sentence that 'a mouse cannot show cytokine release'. Mice do show CRS (Cheadle 2014 syngeneic CD19 CAR; Giavridis and Norelli 2018 at high tumour burden). Is the exemption per species or per model-as-run (tumour burden, conditioning)? Does rule 7 (no later knowledge) bar using 2014/2018 demonstrations of species capability to score a 2011 silence? The myeloma BCMA tile used the species reading; this draft needs the same answer.

Patient-side drug identity: does the academic predecessor construct (NCI FMC63-CD28-CD3zeta CAR, later licensed as KTE-C19) count as the member drug axicabtagene ciloleucel, so that Kochenderfer 2012's three FL patients score the class? If not, engagement/efficacy/safety at 2011 stay untested until ZUMA-5 (2021), which compares with no model.
readout_tier for a depleter whose PD readout is the disappearance of the target-bearing cell (B-cell counts, hypogammaglobulinemia): direct (free target gone), proximal, or downstream?

Mitigation trials in the safety cell: does a prophylaxis trial (anakinra, Park 2023) count as a comparison of the model's safety prediction when the prediction is about the harm's mechanism (monocyte IL-1) rather than the class's harm itself? When a two-part prediction (abolishes CRS and neurotoxicity) half-holds, is it same + source_calls_it partial, or contra?

Member list completeness: tisagenlecleucel (Kymriah FL indication, ELARA, FDA 2022-05-27) and tafasitamab (CD19-directed cytolytic antibody; inMIND, FL approval 2025, verify) are CD19-directed depleters with FL patient data but are not in the tile's members. The drafter rightly did not widen; is the CD19|depleter FL member list complete, and does 'depleter' include CD19 mAbs?

safety 13 (scid-beige-raji-crs-mouse, Park 2023): cohort 1 started anakinra on day 2 or after early CRS, not the prophylaxis Giavridis tested, and severe CRS 6.4% (ASTCT) is close to real-world axi-cel ~7% (Nastoupil 2020, Park ref 11); Blood Adv 2025 (10.1182/bloodadvances.2024015161) found once-daily anakinra insufficient to prevent grade >=2 CRS/NT. Rules do not decide between same+partial (vs ZUMA-1 13%), contra, or untested (condition not tested).

Stated-comparison entries (engagement 2, efficacy 2, safety 2 on the C3H track) now date to 2010 from a pairing (model paper + case report that never names the mouse), while comparison_stated stays true from the 2011 paper: should the 2010 entry carry comparison_stated false?

Jensen 2010 (BBMT, PMID 20304086, epub 2010-03-19) treated FL patients with a CD19 CAR before the C3H model paper (epub 2010-07-14): under the target rule, is the C3H track a retrodiction for engagement and efficacy?

Safety 12: when a sponsor press release is the earliest report but shows only part of the data and a reading that differs from the later registry, does rule 6 date the registry-based status to the press release, or does rule 7 keep the registry date (or require a separate tier-5 entry first)?
